question: Our compliance team is preparing the yearly documentation on data protection activities across the EU and relevant third countries. What specific contents must this annual report cover, particularly regarding practical guidelines and binding decisions?
What must the AI Office do when it determines that a request for assistance is neither necessary nor proportionate?
What are the requirements for general-purpose AI model providers regarding copyright compliance and training data transparency under the AI Act?
Under Article 12 of the GDPR, what specific rights regarding rectification, erasure, restriction, and objection must be communicated to the data subject?
We are setting up a new advisory body for AI safety. What specific functions regarding expert alerts and office assistance must this regulation define for the panel and its members?
Under Article 4 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/454, what must the Commission aim to ensure when appointing a replacement expert?
After testing our business continuity plans, what must we do with the results and any identified deficiencies?
Which EU institution has the authority to request European standardisation organisations to draft harmonised standards for AI requirements?
Which entity is responsible for ensuring that personal data is adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary in relation to the purpose(s) of processing?
How must providers convey the expected performance metrics of high-risk AI systems to deployers?
Which body is responsible for evaluating the necessity and proportionality of a request for support from the scientific panel?

Which legislative instrument, cited in the recital, was implemented by Directive 95/46/EC?
We received a request from a foreign court to hand over customer data. Under what conditions is this request legally binding for us?

Our financial entity has just completed an internal review of its ICT risk management framework following a significant cyber incident. What specific details regarding the incident analysis and the management body's involvement must be included in the final report?

We are updating our HR contracts to ensure that staff members understand their ongoing obligations regarding network security even after they leave the company. What specific elements must be included in their employment terms or agreements to comply with the regulations?
We are preparing for a TLPT and need to know which functions to include. What criteria must we consider when deciding whether to include critical or important functions in the scope?

Under Article 18 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/454, what functionalities must the dedicated interface provided by the AI Office contain?

When a significant modification is made to a contractual agreement, what formal steps must be taken to validate it, and what additional detail regarding the contract's lifecycle must be included?

A manufacturer of a high-risk AI system is preparing for market entry. What specific steps must they take regarding their quality management system, technical documentation, and post-market monitoring to demonstrate conformity through internal control?
When designing a logging framework for ICT systems, what specific aspects must an organization define regarding the scope, detail, and security of the collected data to ensure compliance?
What details regarding the classification of a major ICT incident must be included in the report?
What specific details must be included in the ICT security policies regarding the management body's role and staff accountability?
Our payment processing system suffered a major blackout yesterday. If our standard recovery steps are too expensive or logistically impossible right now, what must our IT recovery plans include?
Which bodies are responsible for submitting the annual report on the application of this Section to the European Parliament, the Council and the Commission?
What specific measures are included to support innovation, particularly for smaller businesses?

Under Article 75b of the AI Act, what must the AI Office do if it considers that the commitments offered by the operator concerned are unable to ensure effective compliance with the relevant provisions of this Regulation?
Under Article 10 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690, what constitutes a significant incident regarding the integrity, confidentiality or authenticity of data in managed services?
What characteristics must the penalties for violating national measures under this directive possess, and what is the deadline for member states to inform the Commission about these rules?

We are a bank updating our internal risk protocols; how often must we review the adequacy of our ICT asset classification and the risk scenarios affecting us?
When does the Lead Overseer have to start applying sub-criterion 1.4?

Quelles entités doivent être informées des incidents ayant une incidence sur des entités financières et des clients sur leur territoire ?
